notes.title: Removal Announcement
notes.content: [h3][b]Dear players![/b][/h3][p]We would like to let you know that Christmas Store: Santa's Supermarket Simulator soon will be removed from sale.[/p][p]We understand this may be disappointing, and we’re sorry for any inconvenience caused.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who showed interest, shared their impressions, and supported the project.[/p]
